item.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
item.description: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.

item.title: 9 dead as jet nosedives and erupts into fireball near busy roadway in South Florida
item.description: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy says all nine people died aboard a business jet that crashed into a Florida neighborhood. The aircraft departed from Austin, Texas, and was headed to the Bahamas.

item.title: Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan Senate race, spurning Abdul El-Sayed
item.description: Rep. Haley Stevens was scheduled to attend a unity event today with Abdul El-Sayed, who beat her in the Democratic primary. Instead, she endorsed his Republican opponent, Mike Rogers.
